title: Python: item 9, an aliased conditional hop still looks up the first-hop name in the S3 target: wrong edge p.f instead of p.g (DEC-303 (a60) item 9, found in GCLI-118)
description: DEC-303 (a60) item 9, found in the GCLI-118 review (opum-ai/glyph-cli#198, landed b3fd5d3e). WRONG edge, predates #198. Input: p.py has def g(): pass and def f(): pass; m.py is 'if C:' with 'from p import g as f' inside; app.py is 'from m import f' then 'f()'. origin/dev 3179ed27, #198's intermediate heads and its final head all give an edge to p.f (p.py:3:5), where Python binds p.g (p.py:1:5). The attribute form 'import m; m.f()' is right (p.g). The unconditional form 'from p import g as f' was wrong on dev and is FIXED by GCLI-118's alias-following chain walk (sourceChainOutcome): the walk ends at a conditional hop (hop.condition !== null returns null), and resolveImportBinding's old targets loop then looks the first-hop name f up in the S3 target (src/python/calls.ts resolveImportBinding targets loop; also symbolInModuleOrReexport). Joins the (a49) item 7 hold list; lands before the freeze.

acceptanceCriteria.text: the reproducing input (m: if C: from p import g as f; p: def g and def f; app: from m import f; f()) resolves to p.g, or to no edge, never p.f, red before and green after with the callee pinned and the full bin delta, in the from-import form and the attribute form
a twin without the alias and a twin with an unconditional alias keep resolving as they do
a mutant that restores the first-hop-name lookup in the targets loop is observed red
the five-pin corpus diff against dev is script-asserted with every moved site named; any in-repo edge created or removed comes to opum-doc before the clear

finalSummary: Landed in opum-ai/glyph-cli#201 (3871e4d5). A lone conditional alias hop is followed with its imported name (p.g, never p.f), and the targets loop no longer looks the first-hop name up in S3's collapsed target after a rename that dead-ends or a plain-import hop (refusal; round 1 B1). Fixtures in both forms, red on the base; mutants observed red (restore the bail 5, drop the plain-import refusal 2, no refusal 6, alias name not carried 9); five-pin corpus byte-identical to dev. Opus round 1 requested changes (B1), round 2 approved. Follow-up GCLI-128 (a lost edge for an aliased hop through a star-only module).
